units.title: be동사 (am / is / are)
units.concept:
• be동사는 '~이다, ~에 있다'라는 뜻이에요.
• 주어에 따라 모양이 바뀌어요: I → am / He·She·It·단수 명사 → is / You·We·They·복수 명사 → are
• 줄임말: I'm, You're, He's, She's, It's, We're, They're
• 부정문: be동사 뒤에 not → I am not / He is not(isn't) / They are not(aren't)
• 의문문: be동사를 주어 앞으로 → Are you ~? / Is he ~?
  대답: Yes, I am. / No, he isn't.

examples.en: I am a middle school student.
My parents are at home now.
She is not in the classroom.
Is this your bag? — Yes, it is.

basic.x: your brother(3인칭 단수) → Is로 시작하는 의문문

basic.a: They are not in the library now

drill.x: be동사 의문문은 be동사로 대답 → No, she isn't.
He는 is를 써요 → He is my uncle.

drill.a: How old is your sister

units.title: 일반동사 현재형
units.concept:
• 일반동사: be동사·조동사가 아닌 동사 (play, like, study, go …)
• 주어가 3인칭 단수(He, She, It, Tom …)면 동사에 -s / -es
  - 대부분 +s: plays, likes
  - -s, -sh, -ch, -x, -o로 끝나면 +es: watches, goes, does
  - 자음+y → y를 i로 바꾸고 +es: study → studies
  - have → has
• 부정문: do not(don't) / does not(doesn't) + 동사원형
• 의문문: Do / Does + 주어 + 동사원형 ~?

examples.en: My sister plays the piano every day.
He doesn't eat breakfast.
Do you like science?
She studies English after school.

basic.q: My father ___ (watch) the news every night.

basic.a: He does not study English

drill.q: Does your brother ___ to school by bus?

drill.x: He는 doesn't → He doesn't know the answer.

drill.q: Do you have a pen? — Yes, ___.

drill.a: Where does your mom work

units.title: 명사와 관사
units.concept:
• 셀 수 있는 명사: 하나일 때 a/an, 둘 이상이면 복수형
  - a + 자음 소리(a book, a uniform) / an + 모음 소리(an apple, an hour)
  - 복수형: +s(books), +es(boxes, dishes), y→ies(babies), f→ves(leaves)
  - 불규칙: man→men, child→children, foot→feet, tooth→teeth, mouse→mice
• 셀 수 없는 명사(water, money, bread, information)는 a/an과 -s를 못 붙여요
  → a glass of water, a piece of bread 처럼 단위로 세요
• the: 이미 말한 것, 서로 아는 것, 하나뿐인 것(the sun), 악기(play the piano)

examples.en: I have an idea.
There are three children in the park.
Can I have a glass of water?
examples.ko: 물 한 잔 마실 수 있을까요?

examples.en: The sun rises in the east.

basic.q: 다음 중 셀 수 없는 명사는?

drill.q: It takes ___ hour to get there.
drill.x: hour는 h가 소리 나지 않아 모음 소리 → an
bread는 셀 수 없어 piece로 셈

drill.q: I saw a dog. ___ dog was very big.

units.title: 대명사
units.concept:
• 인칭대명사의 격
  주격(~은/는): I, you, he, she, it, we, they
  소유격(~의): my, your, his, her, its, our, their
  목적격(~을/를): me, you, him, her, it, us, them
  소유대명사(~의 것): mine, yours, his, hers, ours, theirs
• 재귀대명사(~자신): myself, yourself, himself, herself, itself, ourselves, yourselves, themselves
  - 주어와 목적어가 같을 때: She loves herself.
• this/that(단수) ↔ these/those(복수)

examples.en: This is my bike. That bike is his.
examples.ko: 이것은 내 자전거다. 저 자전거는 그의 것이다.

examples.en: I know him, but he doesn't know me.
examples.ko: 나는 그를 알지만 그는 나를 모른다.

examples.en: Please help yourself.
These shoes are mine.

basic.q: This pencil is not yours. It's ___. (나의 것)
He looked at ___ in the mirror. (그 자신)

drill.q: Those are the students. I teach ___.
Is this bag yours or ___? (그녀의 것)

drill.x: 주어 자리 → They are my friends.

drill.a: Those are not ours

units.title: 현재진행형
units.concept:
• 형태: am/is/are + 동사-ing  → '(지금) ~하고 있다'
• -ing 만들기
  - 대부분 +ing: play → playing
  - -e로 끝나면 e 빼고 +ing: make → making
  - 단모음+단자음이면 자음 하나 더: run → running, swim → swimming
  - -ie → ying: lie → lying, die → dying
• 부정문: be동사 + not + -ing / 의문문: Be동사 + 주어 + -ing ~?
• 상태 동사(like, know, want, have(가지다))는 진행형으로 잘 쓰지 않아요

examples.en: I am doing my homework now.
They are swimming in the lake.
Is it raining outside?
She isn't sleeping. She's reading.
examples.ko: 그녀는 자고 있지 않다. 책을 읽고 있다.

basic.x: Look! → 지금 진행 중 → is sleeping

basic.a: He is eating lunch

drill.q: What are you doing? — I ___ a letter.

drill.x: know는 상태 동사 → I know the answer.

drill.a: The children are running in the park

units.title: 과거시제
units.concept:
• be동사 과거: am/is → was, are → were
• 일반동사 과거
  - 규칙: +ed (played), e로 끝나면 +d (liked), 자음+y → ied (studied), 단모음+단자음 → 자음 추가 (stopped)
  - 불규칙: go→went, come→came, eat→ate, see→saw, have→had, make→made, buy→bought, take→took, get→got, write→wrote
• 부정문: did not(didn't) + 동사원형
• 의문문: Did + 주어 + 동사원형 ~?
• 과거를 나타내는 말: yesterday, last week, ~ ago, in 2020

examples.en: I was sick yesterday.
We went to the beach last summer.
She didn't finish her homework.
Did you see the movie?

basic.a: What did you buy yesterday

drill.q: Did she call you? — Yes, she ___.

o: I met him two days ago.

drill.a: I did not write the letter

units.title: 미래 표현 (will / be going to)
units.concept:
• will + 동사원형: '~할 것이다' (예측, 즉석 결정, 의지)
  - 부정: will not = won't / 의문: Will + 주어 + 동사원형 ~?
• be going to + 동사원형: '~할 예정이다' (이미 정한 계획, 확실한 예측)
  - 부정: be동사 + not going to / 의문: Be동사 + 주어 + going to ~?
• 미래를 나타내는 말: tomorrow, next week, soon, in the future

examples.en: It will rain tomorrow.
I'm going to visit Busan next week.
examples.ko: 나는 다음 주에 부산을 방문할 예정이다.

examples.en: I won't be late again.
Are you going to join the club?

basic.q: She is going to ___ a new bike.
___ you come to my party tomorrow?

basic.a: We are going to watch a movie tomorrow

drill.q: They ___ going to travel to Jeju.

drill.x: will + 동사원형 → I will go there.

drill.q: Will it be sunny tomorrow? — No, it ___.
He is not going to ___ (come) today.
Look at the dark clouds! It ___ rain.
drill.x: 눈앞의 근거가 있는 예측 → be going to

drill.ko: 그녀는 그 경기에서 이기지 못할 것이다.
drill.a: She will not win the game

units.title: 조동사 (can / may / must / should / have to)
units.concept:
• 조동사 + 동사원형 (주어가 3인칭이어도 -s 없음)
• can: ~할 수 있다(능력), ~해도 된다(허락) = be able to(능력)
• may: ~해도 된다(허락), ~일지도 모른다(추측)
• must: ~해야 한다(의무), ~임에 틀림없다(강한 추측) / must not: ~하면 안 된다(금지)
• have to(has to): ~해야 한다 / don't have to: ~할 필요 없다
• should: ~하는 게 좋다, ~해야 한다(충고)

examples.en: She can speak three languages.
examples.ko: 그녀는 세 개의 언어를 말할 수 있다.

examples.en: You must not run in the hallway.
You don't have to wait for me.
You should drink more water.

basic.q: You ___ wear a seat belt. It's the law.
It's Sunday. You ___ get up early.
She ___ to finish it today. (have to의 3인칭 단수)

basic.ko: 너는 여기서 사진을 찍으면 안 된다.
basic.a: You must not take pictures here

drill.x: 조동사에는 -s를 붙이지 않음 → He can play

drill.q: She is able to read Chinese. = She ___ read Chinese.
He worked for 12 hours today. He ___ be tired.
You look sick. You ___ go home and rest. (충고)
They ___ to wear uniforms at school.

drill.a: You have to finish your homework today

units.title: 형용사와 부사
units.concept:
• 형용사: 명사를 꾸미거나(a tall boy) be동사 뒤에서 주어를 설명(He is tall)
• 부사: 동사·형용사·다른 부사·문장 전체를 꾸밈
  - 형용사 + ly: quick → quickly, careful → carefully, easy → easily
  - 모양이 같은 것: fast, hard, early, late / good → well
  - hardly(거의 ~않다), lately(최근에)는 뜻이 달라요
• 빈도부사: always > usually > often > sometimes > never
  - 위치: be동사·조동사 뒤, 일반동사 앞 (She is always late. / I often walk.)
• 감각동사(look, feel, sound, taste, smell) 뒤에는 형용사: You look happy.

examples.en: She is a careful driver. She drives carefully.
examples.ko: 그녀는 조심성 있는 운전자다. 그녀는 조심스럽게 운전한다.

examples.en: He always gets up early.
This soup tastes good.
I can hardly believe it.
examples.ko: 나는 그것을 거의 믿을 수 없다.

o: I go always to bed at ten.
I always go to bed at ten.
Always I go to bed at ten.
I go to bed always at ten.

basic.a: She usually gets up at seven

drill.q: He works ___. He is a hard worker.

drill.x: 동사를 꾸미는 건 부사 → sings beautifully

drill.q: I have seen him a lot ___.

drill.ko: 나는 결코 그 날을 잊지 않을 것이다.
drill.a: I will never forget the day

units.title: 비교급과 최상급
units.concept:
• 원급 비교: as + 원급 + as (~만큼 …한) / not as(so) ~ as (~만큼 …하지 않은)
• 비교급: -er than / more + 원급 + than
• 최상급: the -est / the most + 원급 (+ in 장소·집단 / of 복수)
• 만드는 법: tall-taller-tallest / big-bigger-biggest / easy-easier-easiest
  2음절 이상 대부분: beautiful - more beautiful - most beautiful
• 불규칙: good/well - better - best, bad - worse - worst, many/much - more - most, little - less - least
• 비교급 강조: much, even, far, a lot (very는 못 씀)

examples.en: My bag is as heavy as yours.
A cheetah is faster than a lion.
This is the most interesting book in the library.
Your idea is much better than mine.
examples.ko: 네 생각이 내 것보다 훨씬 낫다.

basic.q: He is the ___ student in our class.

basic.a: I am as tall as you

drill.q: This book is ___ than that one.

o: It's the best day of my life.
He is more smarter than me.
drill.x: more와 -er를 함께 쓰지 않음 → smarter than

drill.q: Mt. Everest is the highest mountain ___ the world.
My room is not ___ big as yours.

drill.a: Today is much colder than yesterday

units.title: to부정사
units.concept:
• 형태: to + 동사원형
• 명사적 용법(~하는 것): 주어·목적어·보어
  - I want to learn Chinese. / My dream is to be a pilot.
  - want, hope, plan, decide, need, would like 뒤에는 to부정사
• 형용사적 용법(~할): 명사 뒤에서 꾸밈
  - I have a lot of homework to do. / something to drink
• 부사적 용법: 목적(~하기 위해), 감정의 원인(~해서)
  - He went to the store to buy milk. / I'm glad to see you.

examples.en: I want to be a scientist.
Give me something cold to drink.
She studied hard to pass the exam.
examples.ko: 그녀는 시험에 합격하기 위해 열심히 공부했다.

examples.en: We were surprised to hear the news.

basic.q: She went to the library ___ books.
My plan is ___ a trip to Jeju.

basic.a: I am glad to meet you

o: I went out to get some air.
We need a place to stay.
He decided to buying a car.

drill.q: I have many friends ___ help me. (도와줄, to부정사)

drill.a: His dream is to be a singer
I need a pen to write with

units.title: 동명사
units.concept:
• 형태: 동사원형 + -ing → '~하는 것'(명사 역할)
• 주어: Reading books is fun. (동명사 주어는 단수 취급)
• 목적어로 동명사만 쓰는 동사: enjoy, finish, mind, stop, give up, keep, avoid
• to부정사만 쓰는 동사: want, hope, plan, decide, need, expect
• 둘 다 가능: like, love, start, begin, hate
• 전치사 뒤에는 동명사: I'm good at drawing. / Thank you for helping me.
• 주의: stop -ing(~하는 것을 멈추다) ↔ stop to ~(~하기 위해 멈추다)

examples.en: Swimming is good for your health.
I enjoy listening to music.
He finished cleaning his room.
Thank you for inviting me.

basic.a: He gave up playing games

drill.q: He stopped ___ to his friend. (친구에게 말하는 것을 멈췄다)

drill.x: look forward to의 to는 전치사 → 동명사

drill.a: She likes keeping a diary
drill.x: like + 동명사 (to keep도 가능하지만 여기선 동명사)

units.title: 현재완료
units.concept:
• 형태: have/has + 과거분사(p.p.)
• 과거에 시작된 일이 지금과 연결될 때 써요
  - 경험(~한 적 있다): ever, never, before, once, twice
  - 계속(~해 왔다): for + 기간, since + 시작 시점
  - 완료(막 ~했다): just, already, yet
  - 결과(~해 버렸다, 그래서 지금 …): I have lost my key.
• 부정: have not(haven't) + p.p. / 의문: Have + 주어 + p.p. ~?
• 주의: yesterday, last year, ago 같은 과거 시점과는 함께 못 써요
• 과거분사: go-gone, see-seen, eat-eaten, do-done, write-written, be-been

examples.en: I have been to Japan twice.
examples.ko: 나는 일본에 두 번 가 본 적이 있다.

examples.en: She has lived here since 2020.
I have just finished my homework.
Have you ever seen a whale?

basic.a: Have you finished your homework yet

o: I have known him for years.
drill.x: yesterday는 현재완료와 못 씀 → I saw her yesterday.

drill.q: Have you finished your homework? — Yes, I ___.
I lost my phone, and I still can't find it. = I ___ my phone.
They have been friends ___ five years.

drill.ko: 너는 그를 만나 본 적이 있니?
drill.a: Have you ever met him

units.title: 접속사
units.concept:
• 등위접속사: and(그리고), but(그러나), or(또는), so(그래서)
• 시간: when(~할 때), before(~하기 전에), after(~한 후에), while(~하는 동안), until(~할 때까지)
• 이유: because(~ 때문에) + 문장 / because of + 명사
• 조건: if(만약 ~라면), unless(~하지 않으면)
  - 시간·조건 부사절에서는 미래 일도 현재시제: If it rains tomorrow, I will stay home.
• 양보: though / although(비록 ~이지만)
• that: '~라는 것' (I think that he is right. — that은 생략 가능)

examples.en: I was tired, so I went to bed early.
When I got home, my mom was cooking.
examples.ko: 내가 집에 왔을 때 엄마는 요리하고 계셨다.

examples.en: If you hurry, you will catch the bus.
Although it was cold, we went out.

basic.q: I like apples, ___ I don't like bananas.
She was sick, ___ she stayed home.
If it ___ tomorrow, we won't go hiking.

basic.a: I think that he is honest

o: When he comes, I will tell him.
I will call you when I will arrive.
Unless you hurry, you'll be late.
Wait here until I come back.

drill.q: ___ he is young, he is very wise.
___ you don't study, you will fail. (만약 ~라면)
I read a book ___ I was waiting for the bus.

drill.a: We stayed home because it rained

units.title: 문장의 형식 (감각동사·수여동사·5형식)
units.concept:
• 2형식: 주어 + 동사 + 보어 — 감각동사(look, feel, sound, smell, taste) + 형용사
  - You look tired. (tiredly ×) / look like + 명사: You look like a model.
• 4형식: 주어 + 수여동사 + 사람(~에게) + 사물(~을)
  - give, send, show, tell, teach, buy, make, lend
  - 3형식 바꾸기: give/send/show/tell/teach/lend + 사물 + to + 사람 / buy/make/cook + 사물 + for + 사람 / ask + 사물 + of + 사람
• 5형식: 주어 + 동사 + 목적어 + 목적격보어
  - make/keep/find + 목적어 + 형용사: The news made me happy.
  - call/name + 목적어 + 명사: We call him Captain.
  - want/ask/tell + 목적어 + to부정사: I want you to come.

examples.en: This cake smells sweet.
My uncle gave me a watch.
She bought a present for her mom.
The movie made us sad.

basic.q: She sent a letter ___ her grandma.
My mom made a cake ___ me.

basic.a: The news made me happy

drill.q: Can I ask a favor ___ you?
He lent me his umbrella. = He lent his umbrella ___ me.

drill.a: The teacher told us to be quiet

units.title: 수동태 기본
units.concept:
• 능동태: 주어가 행동을 함 / 수동태: 주어가 행동을 당함
• 형태: be동사 + 과거분사(p.p.) (+ by 행위자)
  - Many people love the song. → The song is loved by many people.
• 시제는 be동사로 표현: is made(현재) / was made(과거) / will be made(미래)
• 부정: be동사 + not + p.p. / 의문: Be동사 + 주어 + p.p. ~?
• 행위자가 중요하지 않거나 일반인이면 by ~를 생략
  - English is spoken in many countries.

examples.en: This house was built in 1990.
The window was broken by Tom.
English is spoken all over the world.
Was the letter written by her?

basic.q: The room is cleaned ___ my sister. (~에 의해)

basic.a: This picture was painted by Picasso

drill.q: Tom broke the vase. → The vase ___ by Tom.

o: The song is loved by teens.
The cake was made by Mom.
The letter was wrote by him.

drill.q: ___ this cake made by your mom?
The game was not ___ (cancel) because of the rain.

drill.x: 일반 사람들이 쓰는 언어 → is spoken

drill.a: The door is locked every night

units.title: 관계대명사 (who / which / that)
units.concept:
• 관계대명사: 두 문장을 이어 주며, 앞의 명사(선행사)를 뒤에서 꾸며요
• 주격: 선행사가 사람 → who, 사물·동물 → which, 둘 다 → that
  - I have a friend who lives in Canada.
  - 주격 관계대명사 뒤 동사는 선행사에 수를 맞춰요 (a friend who lives)
• 목적격: who(m) / which / that — 생략 가능
  - This is the book (which) I bought yesterday.
• 소유격: whose + 명사 — I know a girl whose father is a pilot.
• that을 주로 쓰는 경우: 선행사에 최상급·서수·all·every·the only 등이 있을 때 (특히 사물)

examples.en: I have a friend who lives in Canada.
This is the bag which I lost yesterday.
She is the girl whose brother is a singer.
He is the best player that I have ever seen.

basic.q: I know a boy ___ can speak French.
This is the phone ___ I bought.
I have a dog ___ tail is very long.
The man who ___ next door is a doctor.

basic.ko: 나는 이 산을 오르는 사람들을 안다.
basic.a: I know the people who climb this mountain

o: She is the girl who won the prize.
This is the cake that my mom made.
I have a cat which sleeps all day.
He is a man whose car is red.

drill.q: He is the first student ___ came to school today.
drill.x: 서수(the first)가 있으면 that을 주로 씀

o: The movie which I saw was great.
I met a woman who is a lawyer.
Look at the house who has a red roof.
Tell me the story that you heard.

drill.q: The girl ___ is singing on the stage is my sister. (사람, 주격)
I have a friend ___ mother is a teacher.

drill.a: This is the song that I like the best

units.title: 관계대명사 what · 관계부사
units.concept:
• what = the thing(s) which: '~하는 것' — 선행사를 포함해서 앞에 명사가 없어요
  - What I want is a new bike. / Show me what you have.
• 관계부사: 선행사가 장소·시간·이유·방법일 때
  - where(장소): This is the town where I was born.
  - when(시간): I remember the day when we first met.
  - why(이유): Tell me the reason why you were late.
  - how(방법): This is how I solved it. (the way와 how는 함께 쓰지 않음)
• 관계부사 = 전치사 + which: the town where = the town in which

examples.en: What I need now is sleep.
This is the house where my grandparents live.
I can't forget the day when I won the prize.
examples.ko: 나는 상을 탄 그날을 잊을 수 없다.

examples.en: That's why I love this city.
examples.ko: 그것이 내가 이 도시를 사랑하는 이유다.

basic.q: This is the park ___ I often jog.
Do you remember the year ___ you entered school?
Tell me the reason ___ you are angry.

basic.a: I know what you want

o: This is how I made it.
This is the way I made it.
This is the way how I made it.
drill.x: the way와 how는 함께 못 씀

drill.q: This is the room ___ I sleep. (= in which)
The restaurant ___ we had dinner was expensive.
The restaurant ___ we visited was expensive.
___ is important is your health. (~하는 것)

drill.a: This is the place where the accident happened

units.title: 분사 (현재분사 · 과거분사)
units.concept:
• 현재분사(-ing): 능동·진행 '~하는, ~하고 있는' — a sleeping baby
• 과거분사(p.p.): 수동·완료 '~된, ~당한' — a broken window, fallen leaves
• 분사가 다른 말과 함께 길어지면 명사 뒤에서 꾸며요
  - The boy playing the guitar is my brother.
  - This is a car made in Korea.
• 감정 분사: 감정을 일으키면 -ing, 감정을 느끼면 p.p.
  - The movie was boring. (지루하게 하는) / I was bored. (지루함을 느낀)
  - exciting/excited, interesting/interested, surprising/surprised, tiring/tired

examples.en: Look at the smiling girl.
I found a broken chair in the garage.
The man standing by the door is my uncle.
examples.ko: 문 옆에 서 있는 남자는 우리 삼촌이다.

examples.en: The game was exciting, so we were excited.

basic.ko: 그 웃고 있는 소녀는 내 여동생이다.
basic.a: The smiling girl is my sister

drill.q: The girl ___ a red hat is my cousin.
I bought a watch ___ in Switzerland.

o: I was surprised at the news.

drill.q: There were many ___ (fall) leaves on the ground.
Who is the man ___ to your mom?

drill.a: I read a book written in English

units.title: 가정법 과거
units.concept:
• 현재 사실과 반대되거나 일어날 가능성이 낮은 일을 가정할 때
• 형태: If + 주어 + 과거동사, 주어 + would/could/might + 동사원형
  - If I had wings, I could fly. (실제로는 날개가 없음)
  - be동사는 주어와 상관없이 were: If I were you, I would take the bus.
• I wish + 주어 + 과거동사: ~라면 좋을 텐데 (현재 이룰 수 없는 소망)
  - I wish I had a sister.
• as if + 과거동사: 마치 ~인 것처럼 — He talks as if he knew everything.
• 조건문(단순 조건)과 구별: If it rains tomorrow, I will stay home. (가능성이 있는 일)

examples.en: If I had more time, I would learn the guitar.
examples.ko: 시간이 더 있다면 기타를 배울 텐데.

examples.en: If I were you, I wouldn't do that.
examples.ko: 내가 너라면 그렇게 하지 않을 거야.

examples.en: I wish I could speak English fluently.
examples.ko: 영어를 유창하게 말할 수 있으면 좋을 텐데.

examples.en: She acts as if she were a queen.

basic.q: If I ___ rich, I would buy a big house.
If I had a car, I ___ drive to school.
If he ___ (know) her number, he would call her.

basic.a: If I were a bird, I would fly to you
basic.x: If + 주어 + were, 주어 + would + 동사원형

drill.q: As I don't have a pet, I feel lonely. = If I ___ a pet, I wouldn't feel lonely.

o: If I were you, I would study harder.
I wish I knew the answer.
If I have wings, I would fly.
He talks as if he were rich.

drill.q: If it ___ tomorrow, we will cancel the picnic.
He speaks as if he ___ an expert.
If you ___ harder, you could pass the test.

drill.ko: 나에게 더 많은 친구가 있으면 좋을 텐데.
drill.a: I wish I had more friends

units.title: 간접의문문
units.concept:
• 의문문이 다른 문장 속에 들어가면 '의문사 + 주어 + 동사' 순서가 돼요
  - Where is he? → Do you know where he is?
  - What does she want? → I don't know what she wants. (do/does/did가 사라지고 동사에 시제 반영)
• 의문사가 없는 의문문은 if / whether(~인지 아닌지)
  - Is it true? → I wonder if it is true.
• 의문사가 주어면 순서 그대로: Who broke it? → Tell me who broke it.
• think, believe, guess 등이 있으면 의문사를 맨 앞으로
  - Do you think? + Who is he? → Who do you think he is?

examples.en: Can you tell me where the station is?
examples.ko: 역이 어디에 있는지 알려 줄 수 있니?

examples.en: I don't know what time it is.
I wonder if she likes me.
What do you think he wants?

basic.a: Do you know how old he is

drill.q: Can you tell me when the movie ___?

o: Tell me why you were late.
Do you know where does he live?

drill.q: I asked him ___ he was hungry.

drill.a: I do not know why she cried

units.title: to부정사 심화
units.concept:
• 가주어 it: To learn English is fun. → It is fun to learn English.
  - 의미상 주어: It is easy for me to swim. / It is kind of you to help me. (성격 형용사 → of)
• too + 형/부 + to부정사: 너무 ~해서 …할 수 없다 = so ~ that + 주어 + can't
  - He is too young to drive. = He is so young that he can't drive.
• 형/부 + enough + to부정사: ~할 만큼 충분히 …하다
  - She is old enough to drive. = She is so old that she can drive.
• 의문사 + to부정사: what to do, how to swim, where to go, when to start
• 5형식: want/ask/tell/allow + 목적어 + to부정사

examples.en: It is important to eat breakfast.
This box is too heavy to lift.
examples.ko: 이 상자는 너무 무거워서 들 수 없다.

examples.en: He is tall enough to reach the shelf.
examples.ko: 그는 선반에 닿을 만큼 충분히 키가 크다.

examples.en: I don't know what to say.
examples.ko: 나는 무슨 말을 해야 할지 모르겠다.

basic.q: It is difficult ___ me to solve this problem.
It was nice ___ you to help me.

basic.a: I do not know where to go

drill.q: He is strong ___ to carry the box.

o: It is easy to use this app.
She is enough old to vote.
Tell me how to cook it.
He was too sick to go out.

drill.q: He is too young to watch the movie. = He is so young that he ___ watch the movie.
Can you show me ___ to use this machine? (어떻게)
My parents allowed me ___ the party.
It is necessary ___ you to wear a helmet.

drill.ko: 이 문제는 내가 풀기에 너무 어렵다.
drill.a: This problem is too difficult for me to solve
drill.x: too + 형용사 + for 의미상 주어 + to부정사

units.title: 수동태 심화
units.concept:
• 조동사가 있는 수동태: 조동사 + be + p.p.
  - The work must be done today. / It can be seen from here.
• 진행형 수동태: be being p.p. — The road is being repaired.
• 완료형 수동태: have/has been p.p. — The bridge has been built.
• 4형식의 수동태: 사람 주어, 사물 주어 둘 다 가능
  - He gave me a book. → I was given a book. / A book was given to me.
• by 이외의 전치사를 쓰는 수동태
  - be interested in, be covered with, be filled with, be made of(재료 그대로), be made from(재료 변형), be known to, be surprised at

examples.en: This problem can be solved easily.
examples.ko: 이 문제는 쉽게 풀릴 수 있다.

examples.en: The house is being painted now.
The mountain was covered with snow.
I was given a second chance.

basic.a: The rule should be followed

o: The singer is known to everyone.
The letter will be sent today.
The desk is covered by dust.
The bridge has been repaired twice.

drill.q: The window can ___ seen from the street.
He gave her a ring. → A ring ___ to her.

drill.a: The game will be held tomorrow

units.title: 비교 표현 심화
units.concept:
• the + 비교급, the + 비교급: ~할수록 더 …하다
  - The more you practice, the better you get.
• 비교급 + and + 비교급: 점점 더 ~한 — It's getting colder and colder.
• 배수 비교: 배수 + as ~ as — This room is three times as large as mine.
• 최상급 의미 표현
  - No other + 단수명사 + 비교급 than: No other student is taller than Tom.
  - 비교급 + than any other + 단수명사: Tom is taller than any other student.
• as ~ as possible = as ~ as + 주어 + can: 가능한 한 ~하게
• one of the + 최상급 + 복수명사: 가장 ~한 것 중 하나

examples.en: The harder you study, the higher your score will be.
examples.ko: 공부를 열심히 할수록 점수가 더 높아질 것이다.

examples.en: The weather is getting warmer and warmer.
Please come as soon as possible.
She is one of the best singers in Korea.
examples.ko: 그녀는 한국에서 가장 뛰어난 가수 중 한 명이다.

basic.a: Run as fast as possible
